title: The Moth and the Flame
subtitle: Dark Deceptions in the Shadows of Calcutta
summary: When a casual conversation unveils the sinister underbelly of poisonings and secret crimes, master detective Byomkesh Bakshi senses a deeper, more chilling mystery lurking beneath the surface. As the veneer of civility slowly cracks, the hunt for a hidden predator begins—where even the gentlest face might conceal a deadly intent. Dive into a world where every word and gesture could be a clue.
